name: Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, and preparation of nanofilms worldwide. It offers plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment, processes, and materials for smartphones and tablets, automotive electronics, audio and wearables, and other electronics. Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd was founded in 2016 and is based in Wuxi, China. Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Favored Tech Corporation Limited.
